transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you for seeing me. Um... I hope I'm not wasting your time, but... well, I guess what brought me in is that people keep saying I’m not listening to them. 

It's mainly my wife, or my supervisor at the plant. They’ll be talking straight to me, and... I really don't mean to be rude, I swear I try to pay attention. But a minute later I just kind of realize I only caught half of what they said, and I end up having to ask them to say it all again. It's a little embarrassing, honestly, because I really do want to do a good job and be a good husband. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm explaining things right for you.
Do you find your mind is wandering when you're not catching what people are saying, or do you feel like you're trying to focus but just can't seem to understand what's being said?

Um, wow, that's a really good question, doctor. I... I guess I'm not totally sure? 

I definitely don't want you to think I'm just daydreaming or goofing off when they talk. I really do try to focus on them, I promise. It's not that I don't understand the words or the instructions for the line, it's just... I don't know, I haven't really noticed exactly what my brain is doing right in that exact moment. It just kind of slips away for a second, and then I realize I missed it. 

I hope that's okay to say? I just haven't really thought about it quite like that before. Am I answering your question right?
When you realize you've missed part of what someone was saying, do you often find that you were thinking about something else entirely?

Um, honestly, no... not really? I mean, I really don't want it to sound like I'm just sitting there planning my weekend or ignoring my wife to think about baseball or something. I really try hard not to do that, I respect them too much for that. 

It's more like... I don't know, maybe my mind just kind of goes blank? Or I'm just not registering the words for a second? I don't usually catch myself deep in thought about some other specific thing, if that makes sense. I just suddenly realize I missed the last sentence they said. 

Is that... is that an okay answer? I'm sorry if I'm not explaining it very well, I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to figure this out.
Do you have trouble completing tasks at work or at home that require you to concentrate for a long time?

Um, well, I wouldn't say I have *trouble* completing them. I mean, I definitely get the job done! I don't want you to think I'm slacking off on the line or leaving things half-finished around the house for my wife to deal with. I always make sure the work is finished, I promise. 

I guess... well, sometimes if it's a really long task, maybe I take a few more breaks than the other guys? Just to, you know, stretch my legs or grab a coffee so I can come back and do my best work. But I wouldn't call it trouble, exactly. I just like to make sure I'm staying sharp. 

Does that sound alright? I hope that's the kind of thing you're looking for. I just want to be honest that I really do work hard and get things done.
Do you feel anxious or stressed when you realize you've missed part of what someone was saying?

Um, anxious? Well, I wouldn't say I get really stressed out or anything like that. I don't want you to think I'm, you know, falling apart or getting super worked up every time I miss a word. I'm usually pretty easygoing! 

I guess... well, maybe I feel a little bad? Just because, like I said, I really respect the guys at the plant and my wife, and I don't want them to think I don't care about what they're telling me. So I might feel a tiny bit guilty for a second, but I usually just smile and nod, or maybe make a little joke to smooth it over so it's not a big deal. 

I definitely don't let it ruin my day or anything. Is that... does that make sense? I hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answer.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?

Um, well... I guess I do move around a little bit? But I really don't think it's a big problem or anything. I don't want you to picture me, like, jumping out of my seat or being disruptive when people are trying to talk. I'm always paying attention!

It's just, you know, if I'm sitting in a safety huddle at the plant, or even just at the dinner table with my wife... I might just have a little energy to burn off? Like, maybe my leg starts bouncing a bit, or I'll just be fiddling with a pen or my keys in my hands. Just small things, you know, to keep my hands busy. 

Sometimes the guys at work will joke that I'm shaking the whole bench, but they're just giving me a hard time, I'm sure it's not that bad. I just like to stay alert, you know? 

Is that... I mean, is that normal? I hope that's an okay answer. I really try to be respectful when I'm sitting with people, I promise.
Do you find it hard to focus on one thing for a long period of time?

Um, focus on one thing? Well, I wouldn't say it's *hard*, exactly. I don't want to sound like I'm not dedicated to my work, because I really am. I always make sure the line keeps moving, and I'm a really hard worker. 

I guess... well, I do like to keep things moving? Like, if I'm doing the same exact thing for hours and hours, I might just... kind of look around a little bit, or think about what else needs getting done. Just to keep my mind fresh, you know? I don't think it means I can't focus. I'm just good at multitasking, maybe? 

I mean, I definitely don't just stare off into space and ignore my job. I'm always on top of things. I just... I like a little variety, I guess. Is that what you mean? I hope I'm answering this right. I just want to make sure you know I'm a reliable guy.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?

Um, act on impulse? I mean, I really try to be thoughtful about what I do. I wouldn't want you to think I'm just running around doing crazy things without caring about the consequences. I take my responsibilities at the plant and at home very seriously.

I guess... sometimes I might just jump in to help fix a problem on the line before the supervisor gives the official go-ahead? But that's just because I want to keep things running smooth, you know? I'm just trying to be proactive. And maybe at home, I might buy something small we don't strictly need, like a new tool or something, but I always make sure the bills are paid first. 

I definitely don't do anything dangerous or reckless. I'm a family man, after all. I just... sometimes I act quickly when I see something that needs doing. Does that sound okay? I hope I'm not making myself sound irresponsible, I just want to be honest with you.
Do you have trouble organizing your tasks or activities?

Um, trouble organizing? Well, I wouldn't say I have *trouble* with it. I mean, I don't want you to think I'm a mess or that I don't know what I'm doing. I always get the job done at the plant, and I never miss a shift. I'm really dedicated.

I guess... well, I might not be the kind of guy who makes a lot of lists or uses a planner, you know? I kind of just keep it all up here in my head. Sometimes my wife might say my workbench in the garage is a little cluttered, but I always know exactly where everything is! It's an organized chaos, I guess you could say. 

And at work, maybe I bounce around between a few different tasks if things get busy, but it all gets finished by the end of the day. I just like to tackle things as they come up instead of planning every little step out. 

I definitely don't let things fall through the cracks, though. I'm really on top of my responsibilities. Is that... does that make sense? I hope that's a good answer. I just want to show that I'm a hard worker, even if I do things a little differently.
Do you think your main problem is that you have trouble paying attention or that you act too quickly without thinking?

Um, my main problem? Well, I don't know if I'd call it a *problem*, really. I mean, I don't want to sound like I'm broken or anything. I'm a really capable guy, you know? 

I guess... I'm not really sure which one it is. Maybe a little of both? Or neither? I mean, I definitely don't have trouble paying attention to the important stuff. Like I said, I'm always on top of my work at the plant. And acting too quickly... I just like to get things done, you know? I don't want to be the guy holding up the line because I'm overthinking every little move. 

I just try to do my best and work hard for my family. I don't really know how to label it between those two things. I'm sorry, is that a bad answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. I'm just a regular guy trying to do a good job.
Do you think you have more trouble sitting still and waiting for things to happen or more trouble remembering what people tell you?

Um, sitting still or remembering? Gosh, I... I wouldn't really say I have a big problem with either of those, to be honest. I hope I don't sound like I'm just disagreeing with everything you ask, I really am trying to be helpful! 

It's just, my memory is pretty good. If the foreman tells me something important, I make sure I remember it. And the sitting still part... well, I just like to stay active, you know? I'm not really a 'sit around and wait' kind of guy, but I think that's just because I want to be productive. I don't want you to picture me bouncing off the walls or anything crazy like that. I can sit down for a meal with my family just fine. I just prefer being on my feet, getting things done instead of twiddling my thumbs. 

Does that... is that the kind of answer you're looking for? I just want to make sure I'm giving you a clear picture of how I am.
Do you think you have more trouble with interrupting others when they're talking or with following through on instructions you're given?

Um, following instructions or interrupting? Well, I definitely don't have trouble following instructions. Like I said, I always do exactly what the foreman needs me to do. I'm really reliable that way. 

But, um... I guess maybe the interrupting part? But not really with talking, exactly. It's more like... well, at the plant, if I see one of the guys struggling with their station, I might just kind of... jump in. Like, I'll reach over and fix their setup for them, or I'll just start telling them how to do it without them asking me to. 

I'm really just trying to be helpful and keep the line moving, you know? I want us all to do a good job! But... I guess sometimes it rubs people the wrong way. It's caused a few arguments, actually. Some of the guys get upset and say I don't wait my turn or that I'm cutting into their job. I really don't mean to step on anyone's toes, I just see a problem and my hands just kind of fix it before I even think about it. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound like a bad coworker or a bossy guy. I really do get along with everyone most of the time! I just want to be a good team player. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining this right for you.
Do you think you interrupt others because you're eager to contribute or because you weren't paying attention to what they were saying?

Um, eager to contribute or not paying attention? Gosh, I... I really try to pay attention, I promise. I don't want you to think I'm just ignoring people. I respect my supervisors a lot. 

I think it's more about just... wanting to be helpful and show that I know what's going on. Like, sometimes in our morning meetings, the supervisor will start asking a question, and... well, I just kind of know where he's going with it, you know? So I might, um, I might just blurt out the answer before he's completely finished asking. 

I'm just trying to show that I'm on the ball and ready to work! But... I guess sometimes I start talking and then realize I didn't let him get to the really important part of what he was saying. I always feel terrible when I do that. I don't want to come across as disrespectful or like a know-it-all. I just get so geared up to get the shift started. 

Is that... is that okay? I mean, I hope that doesn't make me sound like a terrible employee. I really do try my best to be a good listener. Am I answering your questions the right way?
Do you think you usually interrupt others because you're excited about the conversation or because you weren't paying attention to what they were saying?

Um, excited about the conversation or not paying attention? Well, I definitely get excited, especially if it's something about the plant or a project I'm working on. I really do care about what people are saying. 

But, um... I guess... well, this is actually kind of why I'm here. It's not that I'm trying to ignore anyone, I promise. It's just... people have been telling me lately that I'm not listening to them. Like, my supervisor at work, or even my wife at home. They'll be talking right to me, looking me in the eye, and I really am trying to focus on them! But then, a minute later, I realize I... I really only caught about half of what they said. And then I have to ask them to repeat it. 

I hate doing it, because I know it makes them think I don't care, and I really, really do! I just... I don't know where my brain goes sometimes. I hope you don't think I'm just being rude or blowing them off. I really want to be a good husband and a good worker. Does that make sense? Is that the kind of thing you're asking about?
Do you often find yourself feeling overly energetic or restless, even when you're not actively doing something physical?

Um, overly energetic or restless? Well, I mean, I wouldn't say I'm bouncing off the walls or anything crazy like that. I'm a grown man, you know? I know how to behave myself. 

But, um... I guess... well, sometimes when I have to just sit still, like if we have a long safety meeting at work or if I'm trying to watch a movie with my wife... it gets a little tough. It's not that I don't want to be there! I really do. But it's like... this pressure starts building up, you know? Right inside my chest, and down in my legs. 

It just feels like I've absolutely got to move or do something right that second, or... or I'll just crawl right out of my skin. I try really hard to hide it, though. I'll just tap my foot a little or shift around in my chair so I don't bother anyone. I really don't want to be a distraction. 

I hope that doesn't sound too weird. Is it normal to feel like that sometimes? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of answers.
Do you think your main issue is more about having trouble paying attention to details or acting on impulse without fully thinking things through?

Um, paying attention to details or acting on impulse? Gosh, I... I guess they both happen a little, but... well, I really try to be careful. I don't want you to think I'm just doing a sloppy job out there. I take a lot of pride in my work, I promise. 

But, um, I guess the details part is... well, it's been a bit of a struggle. Like, when I'm on the line, I just get so focused on keeping things moving and keeping our numbers up, you know? I want to do a good job. But because I'm going so fast, sometimes I guess I kind of rush through the quality checks. It's never anything dangerous or really bad! Just... I end up missing little things. Like maybe a wrong label slips by me, or a fitting is a little loose. 

And, um... well, my supervisor has had to pull me aside about it. Because it... well, it keeps happening. I feel just awful when he has to do that, because I really want to be a reliable guy for the team, and I hate thinking I'm letting him down. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound incompetent or like I don't care about the rules. I really am trying my absolute hardest to slow down and catch those little mistakes. Is that... is that the kind of example you were looking for? Am I explaining this okay?
Do you think you have more trouble with not listening when people talk to you or with doing things without thinking them through?

Um, listening or... or doing things without thinking? Gosh, I... I guess I've talked a lot about the listening part already, haven't I? I really hope I'm not repeating myself too much. I want to make sure I'm being helpful.

But, um... as for doing things without thinking... I don't really know. I mean, I try to be thoughtful. I don't want to be the guy who just runs around making a mess of things, you know? I really try to be considerate of the people around me. 

I guess... I don't really think I do things without thinking them through first. Or at least, I haven't really noticed it if I do. I mean, I might jump into a project at home a little quick sometimes because I want to get it done for my wife, but... I don't think that's a big problem. 

Am I supposed to have trouble with both? I just... I want to make sure I'm answering this right. I'm sorry if I'm not giving you enough to go on. Does that make sense, what I'm saying?
Do you often find yourself avoiding tasks that require a lot of mental effort?

Um, avoiding tasks that take a lot of mental effort? Well, I... I wouldn't say I avoid them. I mean, I'm a hard worker. I don't shy away from putting my back into something or doing what needs to be done. I want you to know I'm not lazy or anything like that. 

I guess... well, I don't really think I have a problem with that. I mean, my job on the floor is pretty straightforward, so I don't have to do a whole lot of heavy thinking there, just keeping up the pace. And at home, I do what my wife asks me to do. I don't try to get out of things just because they might be a little complicated. 

I hope it's okay that I don't really have a good example for that one. Is it alright if that's not something I struggle with? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the full picture, but I don't want to make something up if it's not really there. Am I doing okay with these questions?
Do you often feel like you're making careless mistakes or overlooking details in your daily tasks?

Um, careless mistakes? Oh, gosh... I know we sort of touched on this a minute ago, didn't we? I hope it's okay if I just repeat what I said earlier... I really don't want to waste your time. 

But, um, yeah, I guess I do sometimes. Like I mentioned, on the production line, I just really want to keep the numbers up and do a good job for the company. But because I'm trying so hard to keep the pace, I end up rushing through the quality checks a little bit. And, well, I end up missing those little things... like a wrong label, or maybe a fitting that's just a tiny bit loose. 

It's really nothing terrible, I promise! But... my supervisor does have to pull me aside about it, because it... well, it keeps happening. I always feel so bad when he does, because I really want to be someone they can count on. I try so hard to be careful, I really do. 

Does that... does that answer your question okay? I'm sorry if I'm just saying the same things over again. I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Do you often find yourself getting distracted by your surroundings when you're trying to focus on a task?

Um, getting distracted by things around me? Gosh, I... I don't really think so. I mean, a factory floor is a pretty noisy, busy place, you know? There's always machines going, people walking by, the radio playing... it's just normal for where I work. 

I really try to just keep my head down and do my job. I want to be a good worker. I don't think I'm the kind of guy who's always looking around at every little thing instead of working. I mean, sure, if someone drops a pallet or something loud happens, I might look up, but... everyone does that, right? That's just being aware of your surroundings for safety.

At home, it's usually just me and my wife, so it's pretty quiet. I don't really notice getting pulled away by stuff going on around me. 

I hope that's okay to say. I know you're asking these things for a reason, and I don't want to seem like I'm not being cooperative. Is it normal to not have a problem with that part? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of information.
